PR-D6-10 against D3a-55: G59 (notes-D3.md lines 1464 and 1475, written at D3a-55 before any propose line was read) put the subs' own April Fools pranks, styling and games (T4-001's themes) outside the model's scope as particulars; PR-D6-10 proposes a process element under Host framing, the sub administering its play, says in its change field that it would bring into the model what D3a-55 put outside its scope, and leaves the widening to a later model. It is consistent with its provenance and is no amendment: amendments-D6.jsonl holds 0 lines. D6a-09 to D6a-18: between the closes of D6a-08 and D6a-18 no data file moved (model, history, tiers, scheme, assignments, branches, cross-links, the return's ledgers, verdicts, findings, propositions, proposals, amendments, fractal lines, room forms, defects, account) except departures.jsonl, which gained line 21 at D6a-09: J's ruling 1d records the D6a-04 widening of the branch-naming rule as a dated amendment applying backwards, in use from D6a-02 before it was written; retelling-D6.md was written at D6b, between them.

E1b-03 the manifest, whole (manifest.py, E1a, read now). run_manifest.json holds 19 entries, for A1, B2, B3, B4, C2, C5 and D2, each with model, seed and decoding. The fleet figures it covers have complete provenance: stability-B2.md (8 entries), fidelity-B3.md (2), position-B3.md (2), transmission-B4.md (5), transmission-after-revision-B4.md (5), review-C2.md (1), account-readers-C5.md (1), verdicts-D.jsonl (1). The D3 re-check return (adaptations-recheck.jsonl and the rooms' verdict-D-recheck.jsonl) has no entry: each room's run-recheck.json names the readers' model (gpt-6.1-sol) and a session, with no seed and no decoding, so its figures have partial provenance. The figures restated (fleet_figures.py, E1a, and the files), each with FLEET.md section 2's definition and its licence, readers share an architecture with me or with each other, so a figure bounds whether the written instrument decides, never whether it is right: stability 0.807 (B2); agreement at B2 0.800 and 0.756 within the stability rounds, alpha 0.784 over six readers, and at B3 0.786 with alpha 0.782; gold fidelity 0.624 (B2) and 0.645 (B3); transmission at B4 over 90 items (gold, pilot): the scheme decides 21 and 30, fails to transmit 1 and 0, the instrument does not decide 6 and 12, teaches something unintended 12 and 8; transmission after revision at B4: arm 1's readers agree at 0.781 on the uniform stratum, under the 0.807 floor; the position curve at B3: agreement +0.003 over 14 positions (interval -0.015 to +0.022), the arguable rate +0.040; the verdict fleet's readers differ in 163 of 705 rooms (0.2312). No file calls any of them reliability or intra-rater (one B3 note discusses what a second reader would have bought).

E1b-04 opened. Claims against their evidence, from claims.py (E1a) and claims_returns.py (written and run now, output claims_returns.json). Propositions, 9: carried_by pattern 7 (N01, N02, N04, N05, N06, N08, N09) and both 2 (N03, N07); every one names a rival and a falsifier elsewhere. Pattern evidence: each rests on arrows whose order counts carry their denominators (rooms carrying both) and beat a null of 500 shuffles within each room, except A11 (0.600 against a null p95 of 0.670, not beaten) and A12 (no order count), the two arrows of N07. Words evidence: the arrows' 57 support quotes all resolve to their concepts (A21 has none); the findings named (F-004, F-005, F-008, F-010, F-014, F-019, F-020, F-021) resolve. The return's verdicts, accepted lines by op over each proposition's arrows: instantiate 1,095 and restrict 622 for N01's three, against absent 1,203; for N07, A12 instantiated 691 times and A11 restricted 627 times and instantiated 21. Against prior.md section 3, the population pattern was to rest on counts with denominators (held), the order on the clock against section 4's brackets (A20 alone carries a before-h73 reading), the onset contrast (early_late for 20 arrows) and support at held size (no arrow's order test was run at held size; F-009 is the one finding tested at held size). N07 is declared both, but its pattern half is not established, and it is marked theorised and thin: half-validated, as it says, not validated with the other kind's evidence. No proposition is validated with the other kind's evidence.
